summary: Commit efa4c4c does exactly what task 04 asks: renderSysstat takes 'at time.Time' instead of calling time.Now(), printSysstat forwards it unchanged, and renderFrame passes its existing p.at parameter through — no new capture, no edit to top/pause.go or top/help.go. Layout, refresh conversion and load-average formatting are byte-identical; the two new TDD-anchor tests are correct and I confirmed by mutation (reinstating time.Now()) that the equality test goes red. Build, vet, the full Sysstat test filter, and golangci-lint are all clean.
